items.title: Show HN: I built an AI code editor that for teams
items.desc: I built an open-source AI code editor for team collaboration, featuring a built-in sprint board and the ability to assign tasks to different agents. I’d love to get your feedback and suggestions! PR and issues are very welcome
items.author: sirily11
items.descZh: 本文介绍了一款专为团队协作设计的开源AI代码编辑器，旨在通过工具整合提升协同开发效率。该工具的核心功能包括内置的冲刺看板（sprint board）以及将任务分配给不同AI代理（agents）执行的机制。其亮点在于将敏捷项目管理与多智能体任务调度深度融合，通过并行代理协作大幅缩短代码编写与任务处理周期。这款编辑器特别适用于采用敏捷开发模式、高度依赖AI辅助编程且需要精细化任务分工的软件研发团队。作者目前正积极寻求社区反馈，欢迎开发者通过提交PR和Issue参与共建。
items.quote: 我开发了一个用于团队协作的开源 AI 代码编辑器，内置了 Sprint 看板，并支持将任务分配给不同的代理。

items.descZh: Codend 是一款革命性的 AI 编程代理，用户只需在聊天中用自然语言描述任务，它便能自主完成任务规划、代码编写、测试运行并提交可直接合并的 Pull Request。其核心亮点在于极高的安全隔离性，每个任务都在独立的 Linux 沙箱中运行，且仅在用户授权的独立分支上操作，绝不触碰主分支。在具体性能表现上，Codend 能够自主完成诸如将应用升级至 Next.js 16 和 React 19.2 的复杂任务，并确保构建通过全部 96 项测试。该工具支持与 GitHub、Notion 及 Supabase 等主流工具无缝集成，非常适合处理定期依赖检查、定时自动化任务以及常规的 Bug 修复。对于追求代码质量和严格审查流程的开发团队，Codend 是一款能够显著释放生产力的自动化编程助手。
items.quote: Codend 是一款 AI 编码代理。在聊天中描述任务，AI 代理会对其进行规划、编写代码、运行测试并打开准备合并的拉取请求。

items.author: zaynjarvis
items.descZh: OpenViking 是一款专为 AI Agent 设计的自演化上下文数据库，致力于解决智能体在运行过程中记忆、知识与技能碎片化管理的痛点。其核心功能在于统一 Agent 记忆（Memory）、知识库检索增强（RAG）以及技能（Skills），为大模型应用提供无缝集成的上下文持久化与检索方案。项目采用高度模块化的架构设计，集成了 SDK、CLI、Gateway、Webstudio 及丰富的框架插件，代码库已累计超过 3,151 次提交，展现出极高的工程成熟度与社区活跃度。适用于需要构建具备长期记忆、复杂知识问答及多工具协同能力的下一代 AI 智能体，可广泛应用于智能客服、自动化运维及多步推理决策等场景。
items.quote: 面向 AI 智能体的自进化上下文数据库。统一智能体记忆、知识检索增强生成和技能。

items.title: Show HN: Gimbap – A themeable replacement for the macOS Dock
items.desc: title: Gimbap [minho kim](https://minho42.github.io/) Gimbap A Dock for your Mac, with themes. Gimbap takes the place of the macOS Dock at the bottom of your screen. It shows the same apps, folders and Trash, works the way the Dock does, and dresses it up with themes and effects, from a plain glass Dock to lava, water, popcorn and an ASCII terminal. Price: Free for 7 days, then US$15 once, for up to 2 Macs. [Download for Mac](https://minho42.github.io/gimbap/Gimbap0.3.6.dmg) [Buy for US$15](https://buy.stripe.com/6oU00ja2W0OiaKZfBu5AQ01) Version 0.3.6 · macOS 15.6 or later Try it free for 7 days, with every theme. After that, Gimbap needs a licence key to keep running. Themes Glass (the macOS Dock’s own look), Water, Rocks, ASCII, Aurora, Brutal, Y2K, RPG, FPS, Live Fire, Popcorn, Balloon, Glitter, Clothesline, Lava and Fart. Most come in several colour sets, and every theme can take a background pattern and a choice of runningapp marker. Effects play only when you hover over or click an icon; at rest the dock is still and uses next to no energy. Each picture shows the pointer resting on Finder. Glitter Water Rocks See all themes Glitter Party Gold Rose Water Lagoon Tropical Night Rocks Granite ASCII Green Amber Ice Rose Aurora Pastel Sunset Ocean Brutal Lemon Bubblegum Mint Cobalt Tangerine Y2K Holo Bubblegum Lime RPG Gold Silver Crimson FPS Amber Crimson Arctic Toxic Live Fire Amber Crimson Arctic Toxic Popcorn Butter Caramel Kettle Balloon Sky Party Night Clothesline Backyard Sunset Mint Lava Magma Sulfur Fart Swamp Mustard Toxic Glass Requirements macOS 15.6 or later, on Apple silicon or Intel. Permissions Gimbap works without any permissions, and better with these two. It asks for them when you first open it, and you can change them any time in System Settings ▸ Privacy & Security. Accessibility: shows each app’s own items and windows in its menu, as the macOS Dock does, shows badges and minimised windows, and keeps maximised windows above the dock. Full Disk Access: shows what’s in the Trash, and each app’s recent documents in its menu. The macOS Dock Gimbap takes the macOS Dock’s place while it runs: the Dock waits, hidden, at the bottom of the screen under Gimbap’s (press ⌥⌘D to bring it out). Whenever Gimbap quits, even if it crashes, the macOS Dock goes back exactly as it was. Current limitations The dock sits at the bottom of the screen; left and right positions aren’t supported yet. It shows on your main display only. Minimised windows show their app’s icon rather than a live preview. Stacks open as a list or a grid; the Dock’s Fan view isn’t available. Uninstalling Quit Gimbap (rightclick the line between the apps and the folders, then Quit) and move it to the Trash. The macOS Dock comes back as it was. Your licence After you pay, your licence key is shown on the page you land on. It isn’t in your receipt, so email it to yourself or save it as a file from that page. If you’re trying Gimbap already, paste your key in Dock Settings ▸ Licence and click Activate. Otherwise, download Gimbap, open the disk image and drag Gimbap to Applications. Open it from there, then paste your key and click Activate. To get your key again, click Copy beside it in Dock Settings ▸ Licence. If you lose it, email us with your receipt. To move a licence to another Mac, choose Deactivate on This Mac… from the ⋯ menu in Dock Settings ▸ Licence, then type deactivate me to confirm. Refunds If Gimbap isn’t for you, email us within 30 days of buying, with your receipt, and we’ll refund you in full. A refund ends your licence key on every Mac it’s active on, and the money usually reaches you within a week or two. You can also ask for a refund through [Link](https://support.link.com/topics/soldthroughlink), which handles the payment. None of this limits your rights under your local consumer law. Updates Gimbap checks for updates once a day and offers new versions, which are signed and notarised by Apple. You can turn this off in Dock Settings ▸ Updates. Privacy Gimbap collects nothing beyond what a licence needs. See the [privacy policy](/gimbap/privacypolicy.html). Contact [minho42+gimbap@gmail.com](mailto:minho42+gimbap@gmail.com) json {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"WebPage","headline":"Gimbap","url":"https://minho42.github.io/gimbap/"}

items.descZh: Gimbap是一款专为Mac设计的Dock替代软件，背景是它旨在取代系统底部的默认Dock，提供更丰富的视觉体验。核心功能是它完整保留了原Dock的运作方式，如显示应用程序、文件夹和Trash，同时通过多种主题和动态效果进行美化，主题涵盖玻璃、水、熔岩等16种选择。亮点包括丰富的主题库，每种主题支持多种颜色变体和背景图案，且效果仅在悬停或点击时播放，静止时几乎不消耗能量，优化了性能；具体而言，它无需权限即可运行，但可选启用辅助功能和完整磁盘访问以增强功能，如显示应用菜单和Trash内容。适用场景主要是希望自定义Mac界面外观的用户，特别是追求个性化和视觉效果的用户，但需注意其仅支持底部位置和主显示器，且不支持Fan view等高级功能。
items.quote: Gimbap 替代了屏幕底部的 macOS Dock。它显示相同的应用、文件夹和 Trash，工作方式与 Dock 相同，并对其进行了美化。

items.title: Show HN: Reges Code – a free AI code editor that runs on local models
items.desc: description: Reges Code is a free, localfirst AI code editor. Local models first, automatic freemodel fallback, Reges Swarm model teams and an agent that admits when it did nothing. title: Reges Code — the free AI code editor that runs on your machine image: https://regescode.com/og.jpg?v=3 [Skip to content](content) Free AI code editor · v1.0.21 Your editor. Now it thinks. Reges Code is the AI code editor that runs on your machine. Local models first, free models when you want the cloud, and a team of models that checks its own work. [Download for Windows](https://update.regescode.com/download) [See it think](local) Windows 10/11 · no account · updates itself Scroll to explore 01Localfirst Your code never leaves. Reges Code finds LM Studio, Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp, Jan and Lemonade on your machine by itself. Your GPU, your models, no account and no limits. 02Free models No credit wall. Ever. Ratelimited? It moves to the next free model and tells you. Daily free cap reached? Straight to your local model. It never switches you to a paid model on its own. 03Reges Swarm One model guesses. A team checks. Architect, coder, reviewer, security and judge: five models in a pipeline, in parallel or in a debate. Built in, and free with local and free models. 04Honesty check It can’t fake the work. If a reply says “files created” but the turn wrote nothing and ran nothing, Reges Code says so, right under the reply. [Get Reges Code](https://update.regescode.com/download) Free while in beta · v1.0.21 · regescode.com 05Models Local first. Free second. Paid only if you ask. Reges Code picks from what you already have: models on your own GPU, free cloud models, and paid routers only when you choose them. Local Found automatically. Runs on your GPU. LM Studio, Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp, Jan and Lemonade are detected on your machine. Nothing to sign up for, nothing leaves the PC. ✓ LM Studio qwen3.54b free · local ✓ Ollama any pulled model free · local · vLLM · llama.cpp · Jan · Lemonade Free cloud The OpenRouter free router, built in. When a free model is busy it moves to the next free one and tells you. When the daily free limit is reached it goes to your local model. No credit wall. 429 ratelimited: qwen3.827b:free → openrouter/free (free) → daily cap? your local model MCP Tools, built in. Builtin MCP servers, including Reges Swarm, plus any MCP server you add to your config. Extensions Open VSX extensions. The editor you know, with the extensions you use: themes, languages, debuggers and Git. Updates Download once. Updates download in the background, are checked against their SHA256 and install on the next restart. 06Reges Swarm A team of models. Built into the editor. Ask once. Reges Swarm hands the task to a team: one plans, one writes, two read it critically, one decides. It only uses loaded local models and free models unless you allow paid ones. pipeline parallel debate build preset codereview preset research preset 1. 01 Architect plans. Breaks your request into files, functions and checks. 2. 02 Coder writes. Makes the change against your real project. 3. 03 Reviewer and security read it. Two independent passes look for bugs and unsafe code. 4. 04 Judge picks. Compares the results and keeps the best one, with its reasons. 07Honest agent No makebelieve. Every claim is checked. Author: Aman Sachan ([Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=dfgiWLYAAAAJ&hl=en) [amansachan92905@gmail.com](mailto:amansachan92905@gmail.com)) Organization: Independent Systems Research Domain Specialization: Technical Reasoning and Code Synthesis Model Focus: This 4.75 GB checkpoint is profiled and pruned specifically for Python programming, algorithm synthesis, data structures, and formal STEM reasoning. By excising 80 dormant multilingual and general conversational experts, the active 48expert manifold preserves deductive reasoning and syntax generation while fitting entirely within consumer 6 GB VRAM. Custom Domain MoE Pruning Pipeline The MAPLE pruning pipeline is domainagnostic and can be applied to any specialized field (such as medicine, finance, legal analysis, or creative writing) using the scripts in this repository: 1. Calibration: Run engine/maple_profile.py with your custom text corpus (e.g., engine/calibration_corpus.txt or a proprietary dataset) to profile routing frequency and activation energy via llamaimatrix. 2. Selection: MAPLE scores experts according to the composite energy metric and outputs engine/expert_selection_map.json. 3. Container Assembly: Run engine/maple_build.py to slice the unpruned base model and assemble an optimized sub2BPW GGUF container for 100% inVRAM edge execution. MAPLE discovers this latent manifold by profiling live forwardpass expert activations via llamaimatrix, scoring experts via a composite frequencyenergy metric: $$s\_{e,l} = C\_{e,l} \cdot \sqrt{\bar{\sigma}\_{e,l} + \epsilon}$$ where: s_{e,l}: Composite importance score for expert e in layer l C_{e,l}: Empirical token activation frequency (routing count) σ̄_{e,l}: Mean input channel activation energy ε: Numerical stability floor (10⁻⁶) Applied to Gemma 4 26BA4B (128 routed experts, 30 layers), MAPLE excises 80 dormant experts per layer to assemble an optimized 48expert GGUF container capturing 79.88% of active forwardpass activation mass. items.descZh: MAPLE 是一种针对 MoE 大模型的亚 2 位权重结构化剪枝技术，通过流形激活剪枝移除冗余专家，将 Gemma 4 26BA4B 从 9.92 GB 压缩至 4.75 GB，等效 1.48 有效位/参数。它在 6 GB 显存的笔记本 GPU 上实现 100% VRAM 内推理，生成速度达 45.4 tokens/秒，延迟降至 22.0 ms/ token。该方法基于 llamaimatrix 剖析实时前向传播的专家激活频率与能量，按复合指标 s_{e,l} = C_{e,l} · √(σ̄_{e,l} + ε) 筛选并保留 48 个核心专家，可捕获 79.88% 的激活质量。它非常适合在边缘设备部署专注于代码生成、算法推理等垂直领域的 MoE 模型。用户可使用仓库中的校准、选择与容器构建脚本，将该技术迁移至金融、医疗等其他专业场景。
items.quote: MAPLE 通过 llamaimatrix 对实时前向传播专家激活进行剖析，从而发现这一潜在流形，并通过复合频率能量指标对专家进行评分。

items.descZh: Laplace's Scissors 是一款专为开源大语言模型（LLM）设计的保护性读取旋转工具，旨在通过旋转模型的输出矩阵来修复弱输出方向，同时完好保留成功的生成结果。该工具提供了从模型抓取、隐藏状态探针诊断、输出矩阵旋转修复，到跨检查点缩放偏差分析的全流程功能，支持 CUDA 和 HIP 后端。其核心架构采用 Rust 处理模型加载、分词与高效编辑计算，结合 Python Triton 3.8 引擎进行 GPU 内核编译与执行，实现了低延迟的矩阵旋转与 GPU 实时验证。工具能够通过探针精确定位层间消减和弱判别方向，并基于期望答案计算旋转矩阵，仅对失败的输出进行精准修复，同时对成功答案施加保护条件，确保编辑不引入副作用。适用于需要安全微调开源大模型输出、保护关键领域正确性、并分析模型随规模变化产生的生成偏差等高级研发与审计场景。
